body.summary: A Netflix animated adaptation of the Castlevania games, beginning with Vlad Dracula Tepes's wife Lisa being burned at the stake by the Church and Dracula summoning an army of demons to wipe out Wallachia. Trevor Belmont, last of a disgraced monster-hunting family, joins the speaker-magician Sypha Belnades and Dracula's half-vampire son Alucard to fight him; they kill Dracula in a climactic battle. The later seasons turn to the power vacuum: Carmilla and her sisters scheme to build a vampire empire, the forge masters Isaac and Hector are drawn into it, and the trio plus a new ally, the vampire hunter Saint Germain, face Death itself, ||who is trying to resurrect Dracula||. The series ends with the trio defeating Death and Dracula and Lisa returning to life.

arcs.summary: Dracula's war of extermination against humanity after Lisa's death, and the trio's campaign to stop him, ending in his death.
Carmilla's plot to seize power from Dracula and build a vampire empire, drawing Hector and Lenore into it.
Isaac's pilgrimage of vengeance and philosophy after Dracula's fall.
Saint Germain's search and the trio's final fight against Death, ||ending with Dracula and Lisa restored||.

motifs: the Belmont whip and the family's disgraced name
blood as both food and bond
forged night creatures raised from corpses
running water as a vampire weakness debated at length
themes: faith and the corruption of the Church
power and the ambition of the undead

notable_scenes.summary: Lisa is burned at the stake, and Dracula vows to destroy humanity.
Trevor, Sypha and Alucard fight Dracula in the castle; Alucard strikes the killing blow.
Carmilla mocks Godbrand and the war council descends into squabbling.
Lenore binds Hector with a ring, making him her servant.
Isaac and Hector's paths converge amid the forge masters' schemes.
The trio and Saint Germain confront Death.
